name: Balance Format 16 Choice
definition: Choice between balance, eligible balance and not eligible balance formats.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Provides information about balance related to a corporate action.

EligibleBalance.name: Eligible Balance
EligibleBalance.definition: Provide eligible balance information in different formats.

NotEligibleBalance.name: Not Eligible Balance
NotEligibleBalance.definition: Provide not eligible balance information in different formats.

FullPeriodUnits.name: Full Period Units
FullPeriodUnits.definition: Number of units of a fund that were purchased in a previous distribution period and/or held at the beginning of a distribution period, for example Group I Units in the UK.

PartWayPeriodUnits.name: Part Way Period Units
PartWayPeriodUnits.definition: Number of units of a fund that were purchased part way throughout a distribution period, for example Group II Units in the U.K.
